rows.ja: 競合(IRENの年次報告に記載)

relations.text: NVIDIAは、IRENのAIクラウド向けGPU・関連機器の限られた供給元の1社に入る
relations.text_en: NVIDIA is one of a limited number of suppliers of GPUs and related equipment for IREN's AI Cloud.

source.label: IREN 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: from a limited number of suppliers, including NVIDIA, AMD, Dell Technologies, Lenovo, Supermicro, Gigabyte and leading storage and networking providers

relations.text: NVIDIAの社内AI・研究向けに、5年間・約34億ドルのクラウドサービス契約を締結
relations.text_en: Signed a five-year, approximately $3.4B cloud services contract with NVIDIA for its internal AI and research workloads

source.label: IREN 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: in May 2026 we entered into a five-year cloud services contract with NVIDIA to support its internal AI and research workloads representing approximately $3.4 billion of total contract value

relations.text: NVIDIAと、最大5GWのNVIDIA DSX準拠AI基盤で戦略的提携。NVIDIAにIRENの株式を最大21億ドル分取得する権利を付与
relations.text_en: Entered a strategic partnership with NVIDIA for up to 5GW of NVIDIA DSX-aligned AI infrastructure and granted NVIDIA the right to invest up to $2.1B in IREN shares

source.label: IREN 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: In May 2026, we entered into a strategic partnership with NVIDIA intended to support the deployment of up to 5GW of NVIDIA DSX-aligned AI infrastructure across our global pipeline over time. We also granted NVIDIA the right to invest up to $2.1 billion in Ordinary shares, subject to delivery of up to 600,000 GPUs, and certain regulatory conditions.
source.note: 出資は権利の付与で、GPUの納入や規制上の条件があります。まだ株式を持つ段階ではありません。
source.note_en: The investment is a conditional right (GPU delivery and regulatory conditions); NVIDIA is not yet a shareholder.

relations.text: IRENはNVIDIA Cloud Partnerで、NVIDIAのPreferred Partnerの資格を持つ
relations.text_en: IREN is an NVIDIA Cloud Partner with NVIDIA Preferred Partner status

source.label: IREN 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: We are an NVIDIA Cloud Partner and secured NVIDIA Preferred Partner status during fiscal year 2026.

relations.text: Dell Technologiesは、IRENにGPU・関連インフラを供給する1社だ
relations.text_en: Dell Technologies is one of IREN's suppliers of GPUs and related infrastructure.

source.label: IREN 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: from a limited number of suppliers, including NVIDIA, AMD, Dell Technologies, Lenovo, Supermicro, Gigabyte and leading storage and networking providers
source.note: 契約の当事者は子会社のDell Marketing L.P.とDell Canada Inc.です。
source.note_en: The contracting entities are the subsidiaries Dell Marketing L.P. and Dell Canada Inc.

relations.text: Dell CanadaとDell USAが、IRENの子会社にGPUと関連製品をそれぞれ約23億ドル・約12億ドルで供給することで合意
relations.text_en: Dell Canada and Dell USA agreed to supply GPUs and ancillary products to IREN subsidiaries for about $2.3B and $1.2B respectively

source.label: IREN 8-K
source.quote: Dell Canada will supply to IE CA Leasing GPUs and ancillary products and services, scheduled to be delivered in phases during the second half of 2026, for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $2.3 billion
source.note: 契約の当事者はDell Technologies傘下のDell Canada Inc.とDell Marketing L.P.です。
source.note_en: The contracting entities are Dell Canada Inc. and Dell Marketing L.P., subsidiaries of Dell Technologies.

relations.text: Dell Marketing L.P.が、ChildressのIRENの34億ドルのAIクラウド契約向けに、約16億ドルのGPUを供給
relations.text_en: Dell Marketing L.P. will supply GPUs to an IREN subsidiary for about $1.6B to serve the $3.4B AI cloud contract at Childress

source.label: IREN 8-K
source.quote: Dell will supply to IE US Hardware GPUs and ancillary products and services (“GPUs”) for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $1.6 billion payable in installments within 30 days of each tranche shipping.
source.note: 契約の当事者は子会社のDell Marketing L.P.です。
source.note_en: The contracting entity is the subsidiary Dell Marketing L.P.

relations.text: AMDは、IRENのAIクラウド向けGPU・サーバー等を供給する1社となる
relations.text_en: AMD is one of IREN's suppliers of GPUs and servers for its AI Cloud.

source.label: IREN 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: from a limited number of suppliers, including NVIDIA, AMD, Dell Technologies, Lenovo, Supermicro, Gigabyte and leading storage and networking providers

relations.text: IRENのGPU保有分・発注分にAMD MI350Xシステムが含まれる
relations.text_en: IREN’s GPU fleet installed and on order includes AMD MI350X systems

source.label: IREN 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: As of June 30, 2026, our GPUs installed and on order included AMD MI350X and NVIDIA H100, H200, B200, B300, GB300 and VR200 systems.

relations.text: Lenovo Groupは、IRENのAIクラウド向けGPU・サーバー等の供給元の1社を担う
relations.text_en: Lenovo Group is one of IREN's suppliers of GPUs and servers for its AI Cloud.

source.label: IREN 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: from a limited number of suppliers, including NVIDIA, AMD, Dell Technologies, Lenovo, Supermicro, Gigabyte and leading storage and networking providers

relations.text: Super Micro Computerは、IRENのAIクラウド向けGPU・サーバー等の供給元の1社である
relations.text_en: Super Micro Computer is one of IREN's suppliers of GPUs and servers for its AI Cloud.

source.label: IREN 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: from a limited number of suppliers, including NVIDIA, AMD, Dell Technologies, Lenovo, Supermicro, Gigabyte and leading storage and networking providers

relations.text: Gigabyte Technologyは、IRENのAIクラウド向けGPU・サーバー等の供給元の1社に数えられる
relations.text_en: Gigabyte Technology is one of IREN's suppliers of GPUs and servers for its AI Cloud.

source.label: IREN 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: from a limited number of suppliers, including NVIDIA, AMD, Dell Technologies, Lenovo, Supermicro, Gigabyte and leading storage and networking providers

relations.text: テキサス州ChildressでMicrosoftに専用GPUサービスを5年間・約97億ドルで提供する契約
relations.text_en: Will provide Microsoft dedicated GPU services at Childress, Texas under a five-year, approximately $9.7B contract

source.label: IREN 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: On November 2, 2025, we entered into the Microsoft Agreement, pursuant to which we will provide Microsoft Corporation with dedicated GPU services at “Horizon” data center facilities located in Childress, Texas over a five-year average term.

relations.text: 子会社がMicrosoft向けにNVIDIA GB300搭載の専用GPU容量を提供するパートナー作業指示書を締結
relations.text_en: IREN subsidiary signed a Partner Statement of Work to provide Microsoft dedicated NVIDIA GB300 GPU capacity

source.label: IREN 8-K
source.quote: IE US Hardware 3 Inc. (“IE US Hardware 3”), a wholly owned subsidiary of IREN Limited (the “Company”), and Microsoft Corporation (“Microsoft”) entered into a Partner Statement of Work (the “Microsoft Agreement”) , pursuant to which IE US Hardware 3 will provide Microsoft access to dedicated GPU infrastructure capacity in tranches

relations.text: Microsoft Azureは、AIクラウドでIRENと競合するハイパースケーラーの1社だ
relations.text_en: Microsoft Azure is one of the hyperscalers IREN competes with in AI Cloud.

source.label: IREN 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: we compete with hyperscalers, including Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure and Oracle Cloud, as well as specialized AI Cloud Services providers, including CoreWeave, Nebius, Crusoe, Lambda, Nscale, SpaceX and others
source.note: Microsoftは最大の顧客でもあります。企業によっては顧客・供給元・提携先と競合を兼ねる場合がある、と同じ書類に記載があります。
source.note_en: Microsoft is also IREN’s largest customer; the filing notes companies may be customers, suppliers or partners in one context and competitors in another.

relations.text: Anthropicが、IRENと複数年のクラウド契約を結んだと報じられている(The Information報道、2026年10月12日)。両社とも公式には発表していません
relations.text_en: Anthropic is reported to have signed a multiyear cloud agreement with IREN (The Information report, October 12, 2026); neither company has announced it officially

source.label: Dataconomy の報道(The Information報道の引用)
source.note: 公式発表はまだありません。契約の金額・期間は報じられていません。IRENが発表したら公式の出典に差し替えます。
source.note_en: Not yet officially announced; value and term were not reported. This will be replaced with an official source once IREN announces it.

relations.text: Goldman Sachs Bank USAが、IRENのGPU機器を保有する子会社向けの約15億ドルのつなぎ型タームローンで共同主幹事・ブックランナー
relations.text_en: Goldman Sachs Bank USA is joint lead arranger and bookrunner on the roughly $1.5B delayed draw term loan financing IREN’s GPU hardware subsidiary

source.label: IREN 8-K
source.quote: Goldman Sachs Bank USA and JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as joint lead arrangers and joint bookrunners
source.note: 融資関係で、IRENのGPU機器を保有する子会社(Hardware 3)の融資です。
source.note_en: A financing relationship at the Hardware 3 subsidiary level.

relations.text: JPMorgan Chase Bankが、IRENのGPU機器を保有する子会社向けの約15億ドルのつなぎ型タームローンで共同主幹事・ブックランナー
relations.text_en: JPMorgan Chase Bank is joint lead arranger and bookrunner on the roughly $1.5B delayed draw term loan financing IREN’s GPU hardware subsidiary

source.label: IREN 8-K
source.quote: Goldman Sachs Bank USA and JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as joint lead arrangers and joint bookrunners
source.note: 融資関係で、IRENのGPU機器を保有する子会社(Hardware 3)の融資です。
source.note_en: A financing relationship at the Hardware 3 subsidiary level.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係のみ。「報道」は公式で未確認。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Relationships are based on official disclosures unless marked as media reports. Not investment advice.
